text:
maria (CFO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands finance slides — burn is tracking ~+2% MoM. Current projection ~13 months runway under baseline assumptions. asking for questions here.
kevin (CEO): Thanks Maria. Can you share the workbook or model that gave 13 months? want to sanity-check with sales numbers.
maya (eng): Is the hiring guidance we announced a blackout or a prioritization? need to know for hiring plans.
maria (CFO): Not a full freeze — it's a strategic hiring pause. We prioritize revenue-facing roles, security, infra reliability. I'll post the prioritization rubric in #people-ops after this.
sam (eng): Procurement question: do services/contractors still need POs for > $5k?
dana (finance-bot): FYI: procurement thresholds unchanged in the short term. PO required for commitments > $10k annually. P-card limit remains $2k per transaction.
alex (finance-manager): To add nuance: contractor engagements routed through Vendor Pool can be approved up to $7k/mo by the hiring manager + ops lead. Anything with an annualed spend > $10k requires a PO and finance review.
jamie (ops): Our infra saw a 22% spike last week (spot convert churn). Any guidance on immediate cloud cost targets?
maria (CFO): We're running two scenarios in the model: Baseline and Optimized. Optimized assumes reserved capacity + batching improvements (~-18% inference spend) and some rightsizing. We're coordinating with eng-infra for short wins.
kevin (CEO): On sales discounts — can reps offer credits to close Dedicated deals quickly?
maria (CFO): Sales can offer up to 15% credit on Dedicated quotes under $200k total contract value. Anything above that needs finance + rev ops approval. Please route exceptions to alex.
sam (eng): Any immediate action items for engineering teams to help runway?
maria (CFO): Two asks: (1) tag inference-heavy workloads with "team=<name>" in billing labels by EOD Friday, so cost shows up per-team; (2) review and flag underutilized DB/Redis instances for rightsizing by next Wednesday.
sam (eng): Ack — will do.
kevin (CEO): Maria — can you clarify reserve policy and approval steps if we need to draw down reserves?
maria (CFO): Sure. Short snippet from the policy: 
```
Reserve policy:
- Trigger: projected runway < 9 months
- Approval: CFO + CEO signoff required
- Recovery plan: 6-month cost reduction and hiring plan to restore reserves
```
Any draw requires an exec-approved plan and weekly checkpoints with finance. I'll post the full doc in #finance-docs.
sam (eng): super helpful, thanks.
maria (CFO): I'll follow up with the workbook link and a short FAQ in #finance-docs in ~30m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
